findings.text: Freezer core offers a request that attempts to move a target task toward the frozen condition and reports whether this call initiated the transition. It declines when the target is not freezable or already frozen or when the low level marking fails, otherwise it nudges user tasks through a signal path and kernel threads through a wakeup path before releasing protection.
Freezer core exposes a predicate that reports whether a task currently carries the frozen marker by sampling its scheduling state with a single torn-safe read.

Freezer core exposes a thaw helper that clears the frozen marker through a per task callback and wakes the task on the frozen wait channel only when it had been frozen and the restore succeeded, all under interrupt safe spin protection.

Misc controller exports a hierarchical charging API where try charge adds an amount leaf to root and fails when type, owner or platform capacity is invalid, while uncharge releases an amount leaf to root and silently ignores empty or invalid requests.
Misc controller exports a capacity setter that validates the resource selector and then publishes the platform provided ceiling with ordered store semantics, rejecting unknown selectors.

Cgroup namespace handling exports a copy routine implementing clone sharing versus privileged creation with usage accounting and css set snapshot, plus a teardown routine that detaches from the namespace tree and releases references in a defined order ending with deferred reclamation.

Migrated tasks are made to conform to the destination freezer mode while holding the freezer mutex: destinations outside freezing thaw arrivals, while freezing destinations clear the frozen marker upward along ancestors and then request freezing of each arrival.

A freezer object becomes marked frozen only while it is already marked freezing and not yet frozen, after verification that every online child is frozen and that every attached task that is freezable is already frozen; callers must hold the freezer mutex.

State application is a no operation for offline freezers; enabling freezing sets the requested bits and freezes member tasks while raising the global freezer active indicator on the transition from idle, and disabling clears bits and on leaving freezing also clears frozen, lowers the indicator and thaws members.

Freezing requests propagate over a subtree in ancestor first order with cpu hotplug and freezer mutex held plus read side critical sections for online pinning, where the addressed freezer uses its own flag and each descendant inherits the effective freezing condition of its parent through a parental flag.

Misc charging enforces both per group maxima and global platform capacities at every ancestor; on breach the failing ancestor raises an event and all amounts already added along the path including the failing level are rolled back, leaving no partial charge.

Per resource watermarks only move upward through a retry loop that re reads the current peak and replaces it only when the new usage exceeds it, providing a best effort monotonic high mark under concurrency.
Charge failure accounting increments a local failure counter at the rejecting group with notification and then increments aggregate counters with notification at each ancestor up the chain.
Process number charging and release walk from the target group toward ancestors but stop before the root, so root carries no accounting while every intermediate level is updated.

Namespace copy shares the old namespace with a reference grab when the clone flag is absent, and otherwise requires administrative privilege in the creating user namespace plus successful usage accounting before snapshotting the caller css set under spin protection.

A dedicated freezer mutex serializes attach, fork handling, state reads, state application and subtree state changes, synchronizing task migration against mode transitions; helpers that derive frozen status or apply state require the caller to already hold it.
A dedicated interrupt safe spinlock guards per task freeze and thaw transitions, covering the checks for freezable and frozen status together with the low level marking and the subsequent wakeup.
Synthetic signal wakeup for user tasks acquires the target sighand lock before signalling and releases it immediately after, ensuring the wakeup races safely with signal handling teardown.

Descendant and child traversals run inside read side critical sections with online pinning and temporary release around per group work, while whole subtree freezing additionally holds the cpu hotplug read lock to stabilize the global active indicator updates.

Namespace creation snapshots the caller css set under an interrupt safe spinlock without taking the cgroup mutex, and namespace lookup grabs a task lock to pin the target proxy while acquiring a reference.

Process number group state pairs a cgroup state node with wide atomic current and limit counters, a plain wide high mark, two file handles for aggregate and local event notification, and paired per event atomic counters distinguishing limit hits in subtree from ancestor caused fork failures.

Freezer group state observed through these fragments carries a cgroup state node and a bitmask mode word combining freezing, frozen, online, self freezing and parental freezing conditions, with parent linkage used for upward clearing and inheritance.

Misc group state observed through these fragments pairs a cgroup state node with per resource entries holding a plain maximum plus atomic usage, high mark and aggregate versus local event counters, plus file handles for aggregate and local event notification, with a static root instance and a global per resource capacity table.

Cgroup namespace state observed here links a common namespace header with a pinned root css set, an owning user namespace pointer and a usage accounting handle, created through a zeroed allocation plus common initialization.

Freezer mode evolves as a bitmask state machine where self and parental freezing bits compose the effective freezing condition, frozen is a derived stable marker set only after descendants and members quiesce, migration of a task into a frozen group reverts ancestors to freezing for later re derivation, and leaving freezing clears frozen.

Task level freezing moves eligible tasks among unfrozen, freezing requested and frozen stable conditions, where the frozen marker is set through a per task callback and observed via scheduling state, with thaw restoring the prior freezable condition and waking waiters on the frozen channel.

Legacy freezer exposes control files for overall state plus separate self and parental freezing indicators, all hidden on the root, with state reads refreshing descendant markers bottom up before reporting and state writes accepting only the canonical thawed or frozen spellings.

Misc controller exposes files for per resource maxima with write support, current usage, peak usage, platform capacity and aggregate versus local failure events, with maxima hidden on root and capacity shown only on root, wired through a subsystem descriptor shared by legacy and default hierarchies.

Cgroup namespaces expose standard namespace operations for lookup with reference grab, release, privileged install with self attach shortcut, and owner query, while process number groups initialize new instances with an unlimited ceiling and release them with plain deallocation.

Misc and process number accounting treat a negative balance after release as a bug warning, and high marks are explicitly best effort under concurrency with the process number variant using unsynchronized plain accesses to avoid atomic cost.

The root freezer group is non freezable so fork handling bypasses locking for root members, and freezing through the legacy interface emits a one time notice directing users toward the newer freeze control because the legacy mechanism is imperfect.

Namespace creation must not take the cgroup mutex while snapshotting the caller set, misc maxima writes and charges reject unknown names, malformed pairs, unset capacities and invalid selectors, and freezer state writes reject any spelling outside the two canonical states.

Misc maxima use a textual unlimited keyword paired with an all bits set unsigned ceiling, applied as the initial per resource maximum for every new group and recognized on writes alongside numeric values.
Process number limits use a textual unlimited keyword paired with a ceiling defined as one past the platform process identifier limit, applied as the initial limit for every new group.

Misc resource labels observed here cover secure virtualization allocations with conditionally compiled entries, and control file names cover state and freezing indicators for the freezer plus maxima, current, peak, capacity and event views for misc, with defined root visibility and event suffix conventions.

Process number event accounting distinguishes fork failures caused by the local ceiling being reached within the subtree from fork failures observed locally but caused by an ancestor ceiling, with separate aggregate and local counters per kind.

Misc group allocation reuses a shared static object for the root and allocates fresh zeroed storage otherwise, initializing every resource maximum to unlimited and every usage to zero, with release deallocating non root state.

Fork handling leaves root members untouched and otherwise under mutex and read side protection requests freezing of the newborn only when its current freezer is effectively freezing, tolerating races with concurrent migration by design.

Misc status views omit resources whose platform capacity is unset unless the group shows nonzero usage, peak or event activity, so unprovisioned and unused resources stay invisible while historical activity remains visible.

Namespace installation requires administrative privilege in both the caller user namespace and the target namespace user namespace, and attaching to the already current namespace succeeds as a no operation without reference churn.
